name: MADAM-6
summary: MADAM-6, also known as 2,N-dimethyl-4,5-methylenedioxyamphetamine or as 6-methyl-MDMA, is a drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and MDxx families related to MDMA.

uses.text: MADAM-6 has been studied for its potential antiparkinsonian effects. However, no clinical trials suggest the drug is effective against Parkinson's disease.
